recall.minute: Keyword search matches strings; semantic search matches meaning (cheap ≈ affordable; apple costing 80,000 is a phone; author + publisher ⇒ The Glass Palace is a book). RDF: triples with URIs (Rahul ordered Margherita; Margherita hasPrice 250; isOfType Veg); shared nodes join into graphs; 1-hop and 2-hop traversal answer questions; RDF lacks standard predicates (ordered/bought/placedOrderFor). RDFS: rdfs:Class, rdf:type (Ram rdf:type Customer), rdfs:subClassOf; inference propagates types (blueprint analogy); templates and shared nodes in a student graph. Ontology: classes, instances, properties (sandwich: madeOf Ingredient, usesBread; Veg/NonVeg subclasses; 'big potato' instance with taste sweet). TBox (schema) vs ABox (facts); ontology + data = KG. OWL: individuals, property assertions; transitive (egg → sandwich → lunchbox), symmetric (pairsWith), inverse (contains/isIngredientOf), disjoint (hasWife/hasHusband) → reasoner infers and flags contradictions. Stack: URIs → RDF → RDFS/ontology → OWL → KG. Building at scale: NER, relation extraction, LLM triple extraction, ontology learning, entity resolution, validation; DBpedia, Wikidata, Linked Open Data. Uses: Neo4j/Cypher, knowledge panels, Louvain community detection, Graph RAG.
